Deleting an org/project is high-blast-radius and irreversible, and a name typo that resolves to a real resource (or a wrong-but-valid ULID) deletes silently. The codebase already has the right pattern in trail_cmd.go (confirmTrailDeletion gated on CanPromptInteractively, with a force bypass); these commands should adopt it, or the team should consciously accept 'control-plane deletes are unguarded' as policy. This matches the base branch's existing repo delete, so it's a pre-existing gap this PR extends rather than introduces — but it now covers four destructive verbs.
